title: Servo Architecture: Safety and Performance
summary: Jack Moffitt presents the architecture of Servo, Mozilla's experimental browser engine written in Rust, focusing on parallelism across cores, GPUs and SIMD and the safety properties gained from Rust.
why: HN recommends it as an exciting look at how a browser can be rebuilt for performance and safety, including the WebRender ideas that fed into Firefox Quantum.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: This video is one of the most exciting I have seen with regards to web browser performance, and it's Mozilla
